speaker: Doctor
text: Since your chest X-ray and BNP levels are normal, this makes heart failure less likely despite your ankle swelling. Have you noticed any wheezing, a tickling sensation in your throat, or symptoms that worsen when lying flat? Also, do you smoke or have any known allergies?

speaker: Doctor
text: That combination of wheezing, a tickling throat sensation, and a dry cough in a smoker is highly suggestive of Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD).
